description: [PAID $0.001 USDC per call via x402 on Base; errors are free] Block header for Base mainnet (chain 8453) from public Base RPC: block number, hash, parent hash, timestamp, age in seconds, confirmations vs current head, transaction count, gas used/limit/utilization, base fee (gwei), fee recipient and size. `block` = latest (default), safe, finalized, a decimal or 0x-hex block number, or a 0x 32-byte block hash. Useful to check chain liveness/finality or timestamp an event before paying for /api/base/gas or /api/base/tx. Head tags cached 2 s, historical blocks 1 h. Invalid input = 400, unknown block = 404, never charged.
